payload.posture: Read Luke 2:41–52 as one movement in Passover, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus’s parents go yearly to Jerusalem; when he is twelve, return travel gives way to searching, temple questions, an uncomprehended saying, and a return to Nazareth. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Passover.
